containment.note: A burst ring rotor in three 120-degree pieces carries about 68 % of its energy as translation (CALC: centroid radius 0.827 r). A pen cannot be made to contain 5-12 J reliably with a thin wall; the design must exclude a burst (rim stress margin >= 3 at the running speed, over-speed trip, balanced rotor) and the housing is a debris shield only (ASSUMPTION: engineering practice, no pen-scale standard found)

tmd.semi_active: retune k over 4-10 Hz (x6.25 in stiffness): a flexure whose free length a small screw motor changes by 1.9x (k ~ 1/L^3), or a magnetic spring with an adjustable gap (PROPOSED DESIGN)

heel_wheel.note: one wheel pushes along its heading only; across it the tyre grips (a constraint), so an anti-phase drive needs the heading on the tremor axis, which blocks writing across it

omni_heel.note: an idealised heel that pushes in any direction (a driven ball, study D's fallback) at the heel train's continuous force

heel_all_load.note: if the heel carried the whole 1 N writing force instead of 0.55 N: x1.8

sled.note: a rest under the hand's ulnar side carrying 1-3 N of the hand's weight (ASSUMPTION) onto a braked or driven element; outside the pen (a writing mouse); the writer must slide it along the line

gating.duty_note: a 10 mm sine with 6.57 mm of nose reach is inside the reach 45 % of the time (2 asin(0.657)/pi)
